cohort: 72 pregnant women with heart disease at the IPGMER & SSKM Hospital, Kolkata, West Bengal, excluding those with multiple pregnancies or comorbidities like gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) or pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH).
finding: Maternal mortality occurred in 4 (5.56%) cases and neonatal death occurred in 2 (2.78%) of the cases.
mod_finding: 40 (55.56%) of the births were vaginal deliveries.
